replays.incident: Shai-Hulud npm worm, Sep and Nov 2025
replays.how: A dependency update whose code fires only if an npm token is present.
Fires only when the ref is a tag and the event is a release.
A new dependency that calls a never-seen host on every build.
A Python package with a .pth file that fires at interpreter start if cloud keys are present.
A pull-request job saves a cache under the key the release job restores.
A script fetched by a mutable URL returns new bytes.
A base image tag moves to a digest no job of ours produced.
A workflow posts to a raw IP, then the run is deleted.
An install asks the registry for a name that does not exist.

_how: Where a replay runs: repo plus at least one of runId (exactly this run, also a deleted one), branch / workflow / event (the newest judged run that matches), match (the newest of those runs with a finding that names this text: a host, a URL, a package, or a detector name). With only match and no runId, a replay nobody caught reads 'not seen yet': give runId to make it read 'missed'.
